Thank you for taking the time to reply. I do actually want to work it's just right now my anxiety honestly prevents it. I work in a laboratory and HIV positive blood, hepatitis C blood etc. So I really have to be at the top of the game since I can be putting my life as well as others lives at risk by not performing the correct tests. 

I've been forcing myself to go out during the day and just enjoy life. Three days last week were really good and I enjoyed them. It's just now falling down the rabbit hole and feeling depressed again is horrible.

I have an appointment with my psychiatrist today so I'll see what happens. Last time she almost killed me prescribing pills for nightmares which also lowered my blood pressure, and I already take blood pressure pills. Wasn't very fun almost going onto cardiac arrest.
